summary: BGIN Blockchain Ltd filed a Form 6-K on April 24, 2026, reporting its unaudited full-year financial results for 2025. The press release details revenue of $67.4 million (down from $302.3 million) and a net loss of $177.0 million (vs. net income of $66.1 million in 2024). Management commentary highlights a strategic pivot to Bitcoin and Dogecoin mining, scaling back altcoin operations, and cost-focused mining strategies. No transaction, bid, or special-situation event is disclosed. This is a routine earnings report.
